name: Arphaxad
overview: Arphaxad is presented in Scripture as a direct descendant of Shem, born two years after the flood, marking him as a significant link in the biblical genealogical line (Genesis 11:10). He is listed among the sons of Shem alongside Elam, Asshur, Lud, and Aram, emphasizing his place within the Semitic lineage (Genesis 10:22; 1 Chronicles 1:17). The Scriptures record Arphaxad's lifespan and his role as the father of Salah, continuing the covenantal line through which God's promises unfold (Genesis 11:12-13). This genealogy highlights God's providential preservation of His chosen line through Arphaxad and his descendants.
